# @three-ws/avatar-cli

> Terminal-native tooling for on-chain avatars: scaffold, validate, hash, and preview avatar manifests from your shell or CI.

- Repository: https://github.com/nirholas/three-ws-avatar-cli
- Documentation: https://nirholas.github.io/three-ws-avatar-cli/
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@three-ws/avatar-cli
- License: Apache-2.0
- Part of three.ws: https://three.ws
